summary: Southern Copper Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the pricing of $1.25 billion 5.350% senior unsecured notes due 2036 in a registered public offering, expected to close June 24, 2026. Net proceeds will fund the Tia Maria project, capex, and general corporate purposes via its Peruvian branch. BofA Securities, Morgan Stanley acted as global coordinators. This is a plain-vanilla debt issuance, not a special situation transaction.
